---
title: "Trump tariffs 2.0 Update"
description: "New 25% tariffs on Canada and Mexico plus 20% on China take effect, modelled to push the US itself into recession alongside its neighbours."
date: "2025-03-03"
categories: [trade-wars]
---

Tariffs of 25% on Canada and Mexico, plus an additional 20% on China, take
effect the next day, with "reciprocal" tariffs to follow on April 2. Using a
structural gravity model, the piece projects these barriers will raise US
prices by 2.7% and tip the US into recession, with real GDP per capita
falling 0.9% — while Canada and Mexico face even sharper contractions of 3.7%
and 5% respectively. The bottom line: the policy hurts the US and its closest
neighbours more than it hurts China, while generating modest trade-diversion
gains for third countries like South Korea.

**Originally published on Substack**, March 3, 2025.
